subject: POC kickoff — missed today, proposed rebook + ops handoff
messages:

To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@scalegrid.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@scalegrid.com>

Subject: POC kickoff — quick agenda and shared artifacts

Hi Oliver / Emma —

Thanks again for agreeing to the hands-on POC with Redwood next week. I’m attaching the POC agenda and a short prompt-review doc so your team can glance over the cases we’ll exercise.

Quick details:
- Proposed kickoff: Mon, Nov 30 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45m) — walkthrough + prompt tuning
- Hands-on session: 11:00–12:30 PM PT (working session with routing/load tests)
- Goals: confirm prompt routing, validate inference latency with 1–2 model variants, run a short 50-user load smoke test

Please review the attached Prompt-Review.docx and flag any prompts you want prioritized. If you prefer a different model variant or want a specific dataset in the test, tell us and we’ll stage it.

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v1.pdf, prompt-review.docx

Thanks — see you (virtually) Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

We ran into an ops incident this morning (internal outage on our SSO) and I wasn’t able to join the 10:00 kickoff. Really sorry about the no-show — priority here was to get our infra back up.

We still want to do the hands-on session and prompt review. Can we move the working session to either:
- Tue, Dec 1 between 1:00–3:30 PM PT or
- Wed, Dec 2 between 2:00–4:00 PM PT

Also, quick question: will you need an API key from our side or a small sample dataset? We can provide a synthetic CSV.

Thanks — and apologies again for the disruption.

—Oliver

Platform Engineer, ScaleGrid

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@scalegrid.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@scalegrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — quick agenda and shared artifacts

Hi Oliver — no worries, thanks for the update and glad you recovered the SSO.

We can absolutely rebook. Wed, Dec 2 2:00 PM PT works for our hands-on engineers — I’ll pencil that and drop a formal calendar invite once you confirm.

A couple of ops notes so we can hit the ground running:
- If you can upload a small synthetic CSV it’s helpful; otherwise we’ll exercise the sample prompts against Redwood’s demo dataset.
- For the load portion we’ll run a staged smoke run (50 concurrent simulated sessions) then a short burst to ~100 sessions if you want to observe throughput. Please confirm if you prefer throughput- or latency-first routing. We recommend latency-first for an interactive experience.
- Model variants: we’ll bring the amd-q4f and a fp16 baseline. Tell us if you want a different quantization profile.

Internal FYI: @Sean — please prepare the load harness and a one-sheet describing the routing profile and the KV-cache warmup approach. Attach the draft to the thread when ready.

Oliver / Emma — if Dec 2 14:00 PT is confirmed, we’ll include: prompt review, routing check, and a 20–30 minute timed load smoke test.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@scalegrid.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — quick agenda and shared artifacts

Got it. I’ll own the load test side. Draft plan attached — loadtest-stub.xlsx (rows: user-scenarios, ramp, target-concurrency, routing=latency-prefer). High-level:
- Warmup: 2 minutes to populate KV cache, small prefixes enabled
- Smoke run: 5 minutes @ 50 concurrent sessions
- Burst: 3 minutes ramp to 100 concurrent if we see stable latency

I’ll set up the harness in the staging cluster and pin the amd-q4f variant as the default. If ScaleGrid prefers throughput-first, I can switch routing to capacity-prefer; call that out in your confirmation.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks — Dec 2 at 2:00 PM PT works for us. We’ll upload a small synthetic dataset (CSV) to the Drive folder you linked and have a point of contact on the call. Attach: ScaleGrid-SOW-onepager.pdf for procurement visibility.

Oliver will be the primary engineer on the call; I’ll be on to observe and take notes. Please send a calendar invite and any pre-call checklist items (keys, datasets, doc links).

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Emma Li
Technical Program Manager, ScaleGrid
emma.li@scalegrid.com
